summary: XAI Octagon Floating Rate & Alternative Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting that its Board of Trustees unanimously approved, subject to shareholder approval, appointing Rockford Tower Asset Management (affiliate of King Street Capital Management) as investment sub-adviser. King Street manages over $30 billion; key portfolio managers are Young Choi and Terry Ing. The current adviser XA Investments remains, with no change to the 1.70% advisory fee or investment objective. This is a sub-adviser addition, not a forced departure. Confidence is low because while it involves a management change, it is not an abrupt departure but a planned addition, making categorization uncertain.
